LESSON: CLEANING PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.3: Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment, part of Hygiene Practices in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four AGRICULTURE FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: when cleaning the environment. How does cleaning of personal protective equipment promote hygiene?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. sign personal protective equipment used when cleaning the environment.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify personal protective, equipment in day-to-day life,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. clean personal protective equipment for hygiene purposes,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate clean personal protective equipment in promoting hygiene. • in purposive groups, learners are guided to use print and non-print media to search for information or observe a demonstration to identify common personal protective equipment such as gloves, dust masks, gumboots, headgear, overall and canvas shoes, • in purposive groups, learners are guided to watch video clips or demonstrations on how to fingerspell and sign personal protective equipment used when cleaning the environment. How does cleaning of personal protective equipment promote hygiene? 36 • in pairs, learners are guided to fingerspell and sign personal protective equipment used when cleaning the environment. • in purposive groups, learners watch video clips or one on one demonstration on appropriate methods to clean personal protective equipment. • in purposive groups, learners are guided to perform various tasks to apply appropriate methods to clean personal protective equipment such as gumboots or canvas shoes, • in purposive groups, learners are guided to 37 make a display of cleaned personal protective equipment for peer assessment.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: safety and care of self as learners clean personal protective equipment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Personal safety as learners exercises caution while undertaking cleaning activity.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate use of personal protective equipment to personal safety skills learnt in Science and Technology.

Science Specific Signs Dictionary, Digital devices, variety of PPEs (gloves, masks, gumboots, head gear, overall), Cleaning
